topic: The anime considered a total flop that became the biggest franchise ever
hook: It flopped completely. Then became the biggest franchise in history.
script: It flopped completely. Then became the biggest franchise in history. When Pokémon first aired in 1996, toy companies passed on it. Retailers refused to stock the merchandise. Industry experts called it niche. Too Japanese. Too weird. Today Pokémon is the highest-grossing media franchise in human history — ahead of Star Wars, Marvel, and Hello Kitty. Worth over 150 billion dollars. Built on a product everyone rejected. Follow for comebacks that rewrote entertainment history.
